business_summary.text: SRM Contractors is a leading infrastructure company specializing in roadways, tunnels, bridges, and slope stabilization in challenging terrains like J&K and Ladakh.

call_points.text: FY27 capex estimated at ₹250 Cr, primarily for equipment to support new projects.
Slope stabilization projects offer significantly better margins than road projects.
Debt increased due to ₹130 Cr in new equipment financing for Maharashtra projects.
Exploring international opportunities in Oman and UAE, but no orders secured yet.
Order bid pipeline stands at ₹4,271.85 Cr, targeting government-backed terrain-intensive projects.
Appointed Sanjay Mehta as Group Chairman to drive international expansion in GCC and Africa.
Puneet Pal Singh appointed as Managing Director to oversee direct project execution.
Management committed to reducing debt levels post-listing for efficient capital allocation.
Intends to expand footprint into Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) projects.

status_history.evidence: Revenue guidance raised to ₹1,500-1,750 Cr from ₹1,400-1,750 Cr.

entities.name: SP Mangal Murti Enterprises Private Limited
Loran Valley Power Projects Private Limited

operating_notes.text: SEBI's April 23, 2026 warning letter cites FY2024-25 related-party transactions aggregating ₹84.05 Cr and ₹47.40 Cr that lacked prior shareholder approval; shareholders ratified them at the AGM on September 29, 2025.
Bid pipeline stands at ₹4,271.85 Cr as of March 2026.
Acquired 51% stake in Maccaferri Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. (MIPL).
Maharashtra accounts for 46% of the order book by state.
Current order book of ₹3,000 Cr includes ₹2,112 Cr from SRM and ₹850 Cr from MIPL.
Strike rate in slope stabilization is 33-50%, compared to 5-7% in the road sector.
Management targeting ₹3,000 Cr top line in three years.

timeline.summary: 24 Apr 2026: SRM Contractors disclosed a SEBI administrative warning (dated 23 Apr 2026) for entering FY25 related-party transactions of ₹84.05 Cr and ₹47.40 Cr without prior shareholder approval.
On 28 April 2026, SRM Contractors announced it was conferred with the Rashtriya Ratna Samman 2026 for EPC Contractor of the Year.
On May 14, 2026, SRM Contractors filed its final Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 confirming full utilization of ₹130.2 Cr IPO proceeds.
SRM Contractors reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹849.7 Cr and net profit of ₹85.6 Cr, while consolidating JVs as subsidiaries.
SRM Contractors issued FY27 revenue guidance of ₹1,400-1,750 Cr and highlighted its ₹1,844 Cr order book and ₹4,272 Cr bid pipeline.
SRM Contractors Limited’s **Arun Mathur** submitted the audio recording of the Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on 27 May 2026 via the company’s website.
SRM Contractors guided for FY27 revenue of ₹1,500-1,750 Cr and reported a current order book of ₹3,000 Cr.

watchlist.text: Related-party transactions disclosed with prior shareholder approval
Shareholder ratification of cost auditor remuneration

watchlist.response: Attributed to regrouping and reclassification of expenses by new auditors, and unbilled revenue of ₹130 Cr.
watchlist.text: Sharp increase in cost of goods sold and decline in other expenses in Q4.
